entries: **The Windows tray tooltip no longer lists a tool you hid under Hide Sections.** Claude and Codex were always listed, even when hidden, and their lines could push the last tools past Windows' 127-character tooltip limit. A hidden tool's line is now left out; the tool chosen as Tray Display Source stays, because the icon shows its number.

**Menu bar icons are visible again on a dark menu bar.** The Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Muse icons were drawn black even when the menu bar was dark, so on macOS Tahoe they disappeared against it. They now follow the menu bar's text color in light and dark. Reported in #352.

**The Antigravity card no longer goes stale when only its weekly reading is carried over.** When the weekly reading could not be refreshed, the whole card was marked stale, which stopped the 5-hour burn rate, notifications, and the window keeper. Now only the weekly row shows its age, and the 5-hour row keeps working.

**Quota notifications no longer use a reading from before the window reset.** After the reset time passed, the old percentage could still send a "used up" notification or block the next window's notifications. On macOS and Windows, a window past its reset time now ends quietly.
**Projects that use only unpriced models show "—" instead of $0.00 in the report,** including after date filtering.
**The Windows tray now reports a failed status line toggle or hook install** instead of failing silently.
**GPT-OSS, which Antigravity retires on 2026-11-18, was removed from the Claude and GPT model group,** and Antigravity group models with hyphenated names now match your usage logs.
**Gemini 4 Carbon now shows as "Carbon 4".**

**Switching to an account without a 5-hour limit no longer keeps the previous account's 5-hour usage.** The status line and quota-aware mode filled the missing window from the old account, so they could show 99% used on an account that has no 5-hour limit. A missing window is now filled only from the same account. The status-line hook updates to 1.19 and the quota-aware hook to 1.17.

**The status line switch shows as on when only Grok uses it beside your own Claude Code status line.** It showed as off, and turning it on installed the status line again instead of turning Grok's off.
**Quota-aware mode no longer announces a Codex model a second time when you first use it.** A model already recorded from the Codex catalog was announced again from your usage logs.

**New Antigravity models are announced even when every model in the first scan was already known from other tools.** usage did not record that Antigravity had been scanned, so later new models were treated as part of the first scan and not announced.

**The offline check works when NO_PROXY excludes Google.** With a proxy set, usage assumed it was online even when Google's sign-in host bypassed the proxy, so it could run the Antigravity CLI while offline and mark you as signed out.
**Offline prices for Claude Mythos 5 and Mythos 5.2 were added,** and the price-table check now covers Mythos models.

**A refusal from a separate Codex limit no longer shows your regular Codex quota as 100% used.** When a dedicated limit such as Codex Spark or a premium model refused a request, the card marked the regular weekly window as full. Only a refusal of the regular Codex limit does that now.

**Reopening an old Codex session no longer hides newer quota from your other sessions.** After a refusal in a resumed old session, the card kept that session's old reading and skipped newer readings from other sessions. It now takes the newest reading, then applies the refusal.

**The Codex disk cache is no longer rewritten on every refresh when you have forked or subagent sessions.** Those sessions were dropped each time the cache was saved, so the cache was rewritten and they were read again.

**Opening the report no longer leaves the menu bar or tray app about 150 MB larger.** The report was built inside the app, which loaded your full history a second time and kept that memory until restart. It is now built in a separate process that frees the memory when it exits.

**The report is built faster.** It reads Claude Code logs once instead of twice and no longer runs git for project folders that were deleted. On one large history it went from 47 to 32 seconds, with identical numbers.

**Days you used Claude Code count as active in the report even when their conversation files are gone.** Claude Code deletes conversation files after 30 days by default, so those days counted as idle and broke your streak. Active days and streaks now count them, and the heatmap shows them in its lightest shade. The appendix, now titled "How the numbers are calculated", lists those dates under "Usage not included".

**Older Antigravity history no longer lists one model twice or leaves it unpriced in the report.** History saved before model IDs were cleaned up kept raw IDs such as `gemini-3.8-flash-n`, which left billions of tokens priced at $0. They are now merged with the clean name and priced.

**Usage saved only as daily totals no longer ranks as your top project or tool.** Usage from before August 2026 has no project or tool, and the report listed it as the top "unknown" project and tool at $0.00. It now shows as a grey "Old records (totals only)" row at the bottom with an unknown cost, and the trend legend uses the same name. Percentages are unchanged.
**Dispatch conversations started with a slash command get a real title in the report** instead of text like "<local-command-caveat>The command below".
**The Antigravity status line shows the Argon quota for Gemini 4 Argon and Orchestrator (Argon).** It showed the Claude and GPT group or the Gemini group instead.

**Auto-start 5-hour Session is renamed Auto-start 5-hour timer.** It sat under Launch at login and read like a second launch option; it starts the 5-hour timer right after a reset. Behavior and settings are unchanged.

**The Codex card shows 100% used once Codex refuses a request for hitting its limit.** Current Codex CLI no longer logs quota after a refused run, so the card kept the last reading, such as 99% from hours earlier, with an "about N hours ago" warning. A refusal newer than that reading now marks the refused window as 100% used, keeps its reset time, and counts the data's age from the refusal. Once that window resets, the card goes back to the normal reading instead of moving the 100% to the other window. A refusal in another session is found even when a different session was modified more recently.

**The Set Up Status Line button now also sets up the Antigravity and Grok status lines.** The button only set up Claude Code; the Antigravity and Grok CLI status lines were added on the next app launch or by turning the status line switch off and on. They are now set up right away when those CLIs are installed, on macOS and Windows.

title.zh-TW: Codex 額度用完被拒改顯示 100%
title.en: Codex Shows 100% After Quota Refusal

body.zh-TW:
明明額度耗盡被 Codex 擋下來了，用量卡片卻還停在幾小時前的 99%，旁邊甚至掛著「約 N 小時前更新」？現在的 Codex CLI（用文字指令操作的工具）被拒後不再記下額度，卡片才一直停在最後一筆舊讀數。

現在只要有比這筆讀數更新的拒絕紀錄，被拒的那個額度窗口就會顯示 100% 已用。原本的重置時間照舊，資料新舊改從被拒那一刻算起。那個窗口重置後，卡片會回到正常讀數，不會把 100% 移到另一個窗口。

就算別的工作階段（也就是另外開的對話）比較晚修改，卡片一樣找得到另一個工作階段裡的拒絕紀錄。⟦跟信用卡刷爆被退件一樣，以前沒刷成就不記帳，帳上看起來還剩一點額度；現在只要被退刷過，這期就改標全滿，等重置後才恢復正常。⟧
body.en:
Ever get blocked by Codex after running out of quota, only for the usage card to stay stuck at 99% from hours earlier, even showing "about N hours ago" beside it? Current Codex CLI (a tool operated via text commands) no longer logs quota after a refusal, so the card kept sitting on the last old reading.

Now, whenever there is a refusal record newer than that reading, the refused quota window shows 100% used. Its original reset time stays the same, and the data's age now counts from the moment of refusal. Once that window resets, the card returns to normal readings instead of moving the 100% to the other window.

Even if a different session (a separately opened conversation) was modified more recently, the card still finds the refusal record in another session. ⟦Picture maxing out a credit card and it getting declined: before, a failed charge went unlogged so the statement still looked like it had a little room left; now, any declined attempt marks the period as full until it resets.⟧

title.zh-TW: 狀態列按鈕也設定 Antigravity 與 Grok
title.en: Status Line Button Also Sets Up Antigravity and Grok

body.zh-TW:
裝好 Antigravity 或 Grok CLI 後按了「設定狀態列」，這兩個工具的狀態列（顯示在終端機最底下的資訊列）以前不會當場裝上。過去這顆按鈕只設定 Claude Code，其餘兩個 CLI 得等下次重開應用程式，或把狀態列開關關掉再打開才會生效。

現在只要有裝這兩個 CLI，在 macOS 與 Windows 按下按鈕都會立刻設定好。⟦好比逛遊樂園買聯票，以前在入口蓋一次章只放行主園區，另外兩館得等下次入園或出場重進才能逛；現在只要館區有開，一蓋章就當場放行。⟧
body.en:
After installing the Antigravity or Grok CLI and clicking "Set Up Status Line", the status line (the info bar at the very bottom of the terminal) for these two tools previously would not install on the spot. In the past, that button only set up Claude Code, while the other two CLIs had to wait until the next app relaunch or for you to toggle the status line switch off and back on.

Now, as long as those two CLIs are installed, pressing the button on macOS and Windows sets them up right away. ⟦Think of buying a multi-park theme park pass: before, one stamp at the entrance only let you into the main park while the other two pavilions waited until your next visit or re-entry; now, as long as a pavilion is open, a single stamp lets you in on the spot.⟧

items.original: **The Set Up Status Line button now also sets up the Antigravity and Grok status lines.** The button only set up Claude Code; the Antigravity and Grok CLI status lines were added on the next app launch or by turning the status line switch off and on. They are now set up right away when those CLIs are installed, on macOS and Windows.

entries: **New Antigravity models are now noticed by quota-aware mode.** usage recorded Antigravity only by quota group, and those groups list broad families such as Gemini Flash and Gemini Pro, so a new model added to an existing group, like Gemini 4 Hydrogen, was never announced. Models from your Antigravity conversations are now recorded too, with effort and tier suffixes removed so each model is announced once. Antigravity models you have already used are recorded as known, so updating does not announce them as new.

**A stale-data warning no longer pushes the Settings button out of the panel.** When Claude and Codex are hidden, the Settings button moves to the Antigravity, Grok, or Muse card, and that card's "about N minutes ago" warning pushed it past the card's edge. title.zh-TW: 額度感知模式補記 Antigravity 對話模型，同分類新品不再漏報
title.en: Quota-aware mode now records Antigravity conversation models so new ones in the same group aren't missed

body.zh-TW: 開著 usage 等新模型消息時，像 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 這類加進既有群組的新選項，過去根本不會跳通知。原本額度感知模式（偵測新模型並發送提醒的功能）只用額度池記錄 Antigravity。但額度池（只列 Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro 這類大分類的用量群組）只有粗略分類，所以加進既有額度池的新模型永遠不會被通知。現在 usage 也會記錄你在 Antigravity 對話裡用過的模型，並去掉強度與方案尾巴，讓同一個模型只通知一次。已用過的 Antigravity 模型則直接記成已知，更新後不會被當成新模型通知。⟦好比百貨樓層表以前只列「家電」「運動」大分類，舊樓層裡新開專櫃從不廣播；現在連造訪過的櫃位名稱都記下來，同區進駐新品牌才叫得出名字。⟧
body.en: When keeping usage open for news on new models, new options added to an existing group like Gemini 4 Hydrogen used to never trigger a notification. Originally, quota-aware mode (the feature that detects new models and sends alerts) recorded Antigravity only by quota group. Because quota groups (usage pools that only list broad families like Gemini Flash and Gemini Pro) only have coarse categories, any new model added to an existing group was never announced. Now usage also records models you have used in Antigravity conversations, stripping effort and tier suffixes so each model is announced only once. Antigravity models you have already used are marked as known right away, so updating won't announce them as new. ⟦Picture a department store directory that used to list only broad sections like "Appliances" and "Sports," never announcing a new counter opening on an existing floor; now it logs the names of counters you have visited, so a new brand moving into the same zone can actually be called out by name.⟧

Models from your Antigravity conversations are now recorded too, with effort and tier suffixes removed so each model is announced once. Antigravity models you have already used are recorded as known, so updating does not announce them as new.

title.zh-TW: 資料過期警告改放圖示與提示框，不再擠掉「設定」按鈕
title.en: Stale-data warning now uses icons and a tooltip so it no longer crowds out the "Settings" button

body.zh-TW: 把 usage 面板裡的 Claude 和 Codex 隱藏起來後，「設定」按鈕會移到 Antigravity、Grok 或 Muse 卡片上，原本的「約 N 分鐘前」文字卻會把按鈕推出卡片邊緣。⟦就像窄窄的櫃檯立牌硬塞進完整時間字樣，排在後面的按鈕自然被推出桌邊；現在立牌只留警告圖示，把時間收進旁邊的折疊說明卡，太長的店名必要時也縮短。⟧現在放著「設定」按鈕的那張卡片，資料過期警告只會顯示圖示，時間資訊改放進 ⓘ 提示框（滑鼠移過去才會展開的補充說明）。Antigravity 的標題在必要時也會縮短。每張卡片的 ⓘ 提示框開頭現在也都會先寫出時間。

The Antigravity title also shortens when needed. Every card's ⓘ tooltip now starts with the time as well.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版也會發現 Claude Code 與其他工具的新模型
title.en: Windows now notices new models from Claude Code and other tools too

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 電腦上用這套工具追蹤各家 AI 額度時，過去並非所有工具的新模型都會跳通知。⟦跟賞鳥社團的通報一樣，以前名冊漏抄了個人日誌，只會播報兩處保護區的新鳥；現在先把日誌裡見過的鳥記成已知，其他棲地來新鳥也會通知，換新名冊後也不會重報舊鳥。⟧會這樣是因為 Windows 系統匣（桌面右下角放常駐圖示的區域）記錄看過的模型時，漏掉了用量紀錄裡的模型，因此 Windows 上的額度感知模式只會通知 Codex 新模型與 Antigravity 額度池。現在記錄看過的模型時不再漏掉用量紀錄，Windows 也會發現 Claude Code 與其他工具的新模型。你已經用過的模型會直接記成已知，更新版本後不會被當成新模型通知。
body.en: When you track AI quotas across providers with this tool on Windows, not every tool's new models used to trigger a notification. ⟦A birdwatching club's alert works the same way: previously, its roster left out personal logs and only announced new birds from two reserves; now it records birds seen in those logs as known first, so new birds from other habitats are announced too, and old birds are not reported again after switching to a new roster.⟧ This happened because the Windows system tray (the bottom-right desktop area for background icons) left out the models in your usage logs when recording seen models, so quota-aware mode on Windows only announced new Codex models and Antigravity quota groups. Now that recording seen models no longer skips your usage logs, Windows also notices new models from Claude Code and other tools. Models you have already used are recorded as known right away, so updating versions does not announce them as new.

entries: **Quota-aware mode tells Claude once per conversation when new models or Antigravity quota groups appear.** When a new model or Antigravity quota group shows up in the last seven days, Claude hears about it once per conversation along with whether usage's price table knows it yet. New Codex models are picked up from Codex's own model list; models from other tools appear after you use them once.

**The Antigravity CLI recovers automatically after a temporary sign-out error.** When a background CLI check fails once with an authentication error and locks the gate, if the fallback quota check still succeeds with the same credential after six hours, usage clears the marker and resumes using the CLI.

**The Antigravity window keeper also stops launching sign-in pages after a timed-out ping.** When the auto-start ping times out while waiting on an authentication prompt, usage now records the CLI as signed out just like the quota check does.
**The Antigravity sign-out marker is now written atomically.** Concurrent reads by the window keeper can no longer see a half-written file and accidentally reopen the CLI gate.

**A Gemini weekly quota close to its reset is no longer mistaken for the 5-hour quota.** After a CLI check has recorded the weekly reset time, a fallback check whose reset estimate lands within ten minutes of that weekly reset now updates the weekly row instead of duplicating the number into the 5-hour row.

**Earlier Antigravity days in the year view update to the corrected numbers.** The saved daily history used to replace a day only when the recalculated total was at least as large, so days recorded before the Antigravity token and pricing fixes stayed stuck at the old inflated totals. After updating, those earlier days switch to the corrected numbers as long as all of that day's conversation logs and sessions are still on disk; days with missing history keep their saved totals.

**Antigravity thinking tokens are included in report totals and cost.** After output and thinking tokens were separated, Antigravity thinking tokens were left out of the report's output count and cost calculation. Thinking tokens are now billed at the output rate, matching Codex. Antigravity cost in the report will be noticeably higher: that is the share that was missing before, not a price change.

**Failed price table downloads wait 10 minutes before retrying.** When offline or behind a blocked network with an expired or missing price cache, each cost calculation started a new download attempt. usage now waits 10 minutes after a failed download before trying again.

**Replaced price tables are no longer kept in memory.** When the price table was refreshed repeatedly in a long-running menu bar session, earlier tables stayed cached in memory. usage now clears old lookup entries whenever a new price table takes effect.

**Muse Wonder and Muse Ember are priced in the HTML report.** The offline price table only knew Muse Spark, so tokens from `muse-wonder-1.0` and `muse-ember-1.0` sessions were listed as unpriced whenever the downloaded table had no Meta entries. Both now carry Meta's published standard-mode prices; Ember's long-context tier (over 200K input tokens per request) is not told apart because session logs do not record it.

**Quota-aware mode keeps working across multiple conversations on the same Claude Code account.** When another conversation on the same account updates the status file last, existing conversations still receive Claude Code quota warnings and new conversations get their starting overview without waiting. After a `/login` switch in one conversation, idle conversations that switch later no longer mistake the already-updated numbers for the old account's limits.

**Quota-aware mode handles non-ASCII text on Windows, cleans up failed state writes, and stops adding unrelated Antigravity group notes.** It now reads stdin and writes stdout as UTF-8 instead of the system code page so CJK text no longer silences it or desynchronizes saved state from output, and removes its temporary file if saving state fails. The "Other agy model groups still have quota" line now appears only on turns that actually report an Antigravity model group crossing a threshold.

**Antigravity usage is priced again in the HTML report.** The model IDs that Antigravity now records (such as `gemini-4-argon-s`, `gemini-3.8-flash-n` and `claude-sonnet-5-5-medium`) matched no entry in the price table, so all Antigravity tokens were listed as unpriced. usage now drops Antigravity's own suffixes (`-n`, `-s`, `-trial`, `-tiered`, `-low`, `-medium`, `-high`, `-xhigh`) and also looks up `gemini/`-prefixed prices. Gemini 4 Hydrogen is priced too.

**The Antigravity status line names the `xhigh` effort level.** Gemini 4 Hydrogen at `xhigh` used to show the raw English name. It now shows a localized label like the other levels, such as `Extended` in English.

**Antigravity token counts are read from the right fields.** usage added Antigravity's internal model ID (about 1,300–1,500) to the input tokens of every response, so Antigravity input was overcounted. It also swapped output and thinking tokens. Input now comes only from the input field, thinking and output are no longer swapped, and responses that carry nothing but the model ID are no longer counted. Cached Antigravity results are rebuilt once after updating.

title.zh-TW: 額度感知模式在對話中通報新模型與新額度池
title.en: Quota-aware mode announces new models and quota pools in conversations

body.zh-TW: 換上剛推出的 AI 模型趕報告，你可能會納悶 Claude 到底知不知道這個新選項。⟦就像電信公司剛推出新的漫遊方案，以前專員沒收到通報只能自己猜，現在總機會在每通來電提示一次新名稱與費率表有沒有列。⟧現在只要最近七天內出現新模型或新的 Antigravity 額度池（共用同一個用量上限的分組），額度感知模式就會在每個對話告訴 Claude 一次，並附上 usage 的價目表認不認得它。其中 Codex 的新模型會從 Codex 自己的模型清單抓到，其他工具的新模型則在你使用過一次後才會出現。當你剛試過一款新模型、接著開新對話問 Claude 目前有哪些可用額度時，它就能立刻知道這個新成員已經進來了。
body.en: When you switch to a newly released AI model to rush a report, you might wonder whether Claude even knows about this new option. ⟦Picture a telecom carrier rolling out a new roaming plan: agents used to guess without any notice, whereas now the switchboard announces the new name and whether it is on the rate sheet once on every call.⟧ Now, whenever a new model or a new Antigravity quota pool (a group sharing the same usage limit) appears within the last seven days, quota-aware mode informs Claude once per conversation and notes whether usage's price table recognizes it. New Codex models are pulled from Codex's own model list, while new models from other tools show up after you use them once. When you have just tried a new model and then open a new conversation to ask Claude what quotas are available, it will immediately know this newcomer has arrived.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Antigravity 登出閘門與 Gemini 週額度歸類
title.en: Fix Antigravity sign-out gate and Gemini weekly quota classification

body.zh-TW:
背景執行額度檢查遇到暫時驗證錯誤或開窗逾時，Antigravity 過去容易反覆彈出登入頁或錯記數字。

背景執行 CLI（指令列工具）檢查若因暫時性驗證錯誤而鎖住閘門，六小時後只要備援管道用同一份憑證仍抓得到額度，usage 就會清掉標記並恢復使用 CLI。

自動開窗送訊號若因等待驗證而逾時，usage 現在會跟額度檢查一樣記下未登入狀態，不再重複啟動 CLI 在背景開出登入頁。未登入標記也改為原子寫入（寫完整才算數、不讓讀檔看到半成品），自動開窗同時讀檔時不會再誤開閘門。

先前透過 CLI 記下 Gemini 週額度重置時間後，改走備援管道若看到重置時間相差在十分鐘內，會直接更新週額度，不再把同一個數字重複填進 5 小時那一列。以前驗證偶爾卡住就得面對背景冒出的登入頁或錯位的額度欄，現在這些狀態都會自動對正。
body.en:
When background quota checks hit a temporary authentication error or a window-opening timeout, Antigravity used to repeatedly pop up sign-in pages or misrecord numbers.

If a background CLI (command-line tool) check locks the gate due to a temporary authentication error, usage clears the marker and resumes using the CLI after six hours as long as the fallback path can still fetch quotas with the same credential.

If the auto-start window ping times out waiting for authentication, usage now records a signed-out state just like the quota check does, instead of repeatedly launching the CLI to open sign-in pages in the background. The signed-out marker is also written atomically (only counted once complete so readers never see a half-written file), so concurrent reads by the window keeper no longer reopen the gate by mistake.

After a CLI check records the Gemini weekly quota reset time, a fallback check whose reset time falls within ten minutes of it now updates the weekly quota directly instead of duplicating the same number into the 5-hour row. Previously, an occasional authentication hiccup meant dealing with background sign-in pages or misplaced quota rows, and now those states align automatically.

items.original:
**The Antigravity CLI recovers automatically after a temporary sign-out error.** When a background CLI check fails once with an authentication error and locks the gate, if the fallback quota check still succeeds with the same credential after six hours, usage clears the marker and resumes using the CLI.
**The Antigravity window keeper also stops launching sign-in pages after a timed-out ping.** When the auto-start ping times out while waiting on an authentication prompt, usage now records the CLI as signed out just like the quota check does.
**The Antigravity sign-out marker is now written atomically.** Concurrent reads by the window keeper can no longer see a half-written file and accidentally reopen the CLI gate.
**A Gemini weekly quota close to its reset is no longer mistaken for the 5-hour quota.** After a CLI check has recorded the weekly reset time, a fallback check whose reset estimate lands within ten minutes of that weekly reset now updates the weekly row instead of duplicating the number into the 5-hour row.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Antigravity token 讀取並重算年度歷史
title.en: Fix Antigravity token reading and recalculate yearly history

body.zh-TW: 過去在年度檢視裡看到的 Antigravity 每日用量，常常偏高卻降不下來。⟦宛如發現以前錯把箱號當貨數、又把進貨與退貨抄反，現在只要原始單據還在，先前虛胖的舊日報表也跟著一起更正。⟧usage 以前每次回應都把約 1,300 到 1,500 的內部模型編號算進 input token（AI 計費的文字單位），還把 output 和 thinking 讀反。現在 input 只讀 input 欄位、output 與 thinking 不再對調、只帶模型編號的回應也不計入，更新後還會重算一次 Antigravity 的快取（暫存結果）。年度檢視的每日歷史以前只在新總量不小於舊紀錄時才替換，現在只要當天所有對話紀錄與工作階段都還留在本機，偏高的舊日子就會改成正確數值，紀錄缺漏的日子則保留原總量。
body.en: In the year view, past Antigravity daily usage often looked inflated and refused to drop. ⟦Like realizing you used to count box numbers as stock and mix up incoming deliveries with returns, those inflated old daily reports now get corrected whenever the original slips are still on hand.⟧ usage previously added Antigravity's internal model ID of around 1,300 to 1,500 into input tokens (text units AI models bill by) on every response, and also swapped output and thinking. Now input reads only the input field, output and thinking are no longer swapped, responses carrying only the model ID are not counted, and the Antigravity cache is rebuilt once after updating. Previously, the year view's daily history replaced a day only when the new total was no smaller than the old record; now, as long as all conversation logs and sessions from that day remain on disk, inflated past days switch to the corrected values, while days with missing logs keep their saved totals.

items.original:
**Earlier Antigravity days in the year view update to the corrected numbers.** The saved daily history used to replace a day only when the recalculated total was at least as large, so days recorded before the Antigravity token and pricing fixes stayed stuck at the old inflated totals. After updating, those earlier days switch to the corrected numbers as long as all of that day's conversation logs and sessions are still on disk; days with missing history keep their saved totals.
**Antigravity token counts are read from the right fields.** usage added Antigravity's internal model ID (about 1,300–1,500) to the input tokens of every response, so Antigravity input was overcounted. It also swapped output and thinking tokens. Input now comes only from the input field, thinking and output are no longer swapped, and responses that carry nothing but the model ID are no longer counted. Cached Antigravity results are rebuilt once after updating.

title.zh-TW: HTML 報表重認 Antigravity 模型並計入思考花費
title.en: HTML report recognizes Antigravity models again and includes thinking cost

body.zh-TW: 想在 HTML 報表查看 Antigravity 用量帳單，明細上卻整排列成「沒有價格」。⟦好比核對工程報價單，以前型號多了尾碼就整項留白、還少算一欄工時，現在先裁掉尾碼對上牌價，再把漏計的工時補進帳單。⟧Antigravity 記下的 `gemini-4-argon-s` 等型號原本對不到價目表，現在會先去掉 `-n`、`-s`、`-medium` 等尾碼並找 `gemini/` 開頭的價格，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 也算得出花費。報表分開讀取輸出與思考欄位後，原本漏掉 Antigravity 的思考 token（AI 計費的文字單位）。現在比照 Codex 把思考 token 計入輸出並以輸出單價計費，花費會明顯變高，這只是補算漏掉的部分，不是漲價。
body.en: When checking your Antigravity usage bill in the HTML report, every line item used to show up as unpriced. ⟦Think of auditing a contractor quote: extra model suffixes used to leave an item blank while a whole column of labor hours was missed, and now you strip the suffixes to match the rate card and add the missing hours back onto the bill.⟧ Model IDs recorded by Antigravity such as `gemini-4-argon-s` previously matched nothing in the price table; now usage strips suffixes like `-n`, `-s`, and `-medium` and also looks up `gemini/`-prefixed prices, so Gemini 4 Hydrogen can be priced as well. After the report separated output and thinking fields, Antigravity's thinking tokens (text units AI models bill by) were left out. Matching Codex, thinking tokens are now counted into output and billed at the output rate, so costs will look noticeably higher—that only makes up for the missing share, not a price hike.

items.original:
**Antigravity thinking tokens are included in report totals and cost.** After output and thinking tokens were separated, Antigravity thinking tokens were left out of the report's output count and cost calculation. Thinking tokens are now billed at the output rate, matching Codex. Antigravity cost in the report will be noticeably higher: that is the share that was missing before, not a price change.
**Antigravity usage is priced again in the HTML report.** The model IDs that Antigravity now records (such as `gemini-4-argon-s`, `gemini-3.8-flash-n` and `claude-sonnet-5-5-medium`) matched no entry in the price table, so all Antigravity tokens were listed as unpriced. usage now drops Antigravity's own suffixes (`-n`, `-s`, `-trial`, `-tiered`, `-low`, `-medium`, `-high`, `-xhigh`) and also looks up `gemini/`-prefixed prices. Gemini 4 Hydrogen is priced too.

title.zh-TW: 價目表下載等待重試、換表清快取並補上 Muse 定價
title.en: Price table downloads wait before retrying, clear cache on refresh, and add Muse pricing

body.zh-TW:
離線環境或長時間開著選單列程式算費用，價目表有時會卡在重複下載、舊表沒清或模型缺價。

離線或連不上網且沒有未過期價目快取（暫存查詢資料）時，以前每次算費都重開連線下載，現在失敗後會等 10 分鐘再試。

選單列程式長時間執行並多次更新價目表時，啟用新表會順手清掉記憶體裡的舊表查詢快取，不再一直留著。

離線表原本只有 Muse Spark，下載表又缺 Meta 條目時，Muse Wonder 的 `muse-wonder-1.0` 與 Muse Ember 的 `muse-ember-1.0` token（AI 計費單位）全被列成「沒有價格」。現在兩款都用 Meta 公布的標準價，但 Ember 單次輸入逾 200K token 的長文價位因工作階段紀錄沒記，一律採標準價。

以前斷網每算一次就重連、用這兩款模型也算不出費用，現在都已修好。
body.en:
When calculating costs offline or with the menu bar app running for long stretches, the price table could get stuck retrying downloads, holding onto old tables, or missing model prices.

When offline or unreachable without an unexpired price cache, each cost calculation used to start a new download; now usage waits 10 minutes after a failure before trying again.

When the menu bar app runs for a long time and refreshes the price table multiple times, activating a new table now clears old lookup cache entries from memory instead of keeping them around.

When the offline table only had Muse Spark and the downloaded table lacked Meta entries, tokens (AI billing units) from Muse Wonder's `muse-wonder-1.0` and Muse Ember's `muse-ember-1.0` were all listed as unpriced. Both now use Meta's published standard prices, though Ember's long-context tier for over 200K input tokens per request falls back to standard pricing because session logs do not record it.

Previously, offline runs retried the network on every calculation and these two models could not be priced; both issues are now fixed.

items.original:
**Failed price table downloads wait 10 minutes before retrying.** When offline or behind a blocked network with an expired or missing price cache, each cost calculation started a new download attempt. usage now waits 10 minutes after a failed download before trying again.
**Replaced price tables are no longer kept in memory.** When the price table was refreshed repeatedly in a long-running menu bar session, earlier tables stayed cached in memory. usage now clears old lookup entries whenever a new price table takes effect.
**Muse Wonder and Muse Ember are priced in the HTML report.** The offline price table only knew Muse Spark, so tokens from `muse-wonder-1.0` and `muse-ember-1.0` sessions were listed as unpriced whenever the downloaded table had no Meta entries. Both now carry Meta's published standard-mode prices; Ember's long-context tier (over 200K input tokens per request) is not told apart because session logs do not record it.

title.zh-TW: 額度感知模式相容同帳號多對話與 Windows 中文
title.en: Quota-aware mode supports multi-conversation accounts and Windows Chinese text

body.zh-TW: 你開著好幾個視窗同時跑 Claude Code，或在 Windows 終端機裡輸入字句，有時會漏掉警示或突然沒反應。現在同帳號別的對話更新狀態檔時，其他對話仍收得到額度警告，新對話也能直接拿到起始總覽；用 `/login` 換帳號後，閒置對話隨後切換也不再誤記成舊帳號額度。讀寫標準輸入與輸出改固定用 UTF-8（跨語言通用文字編碼），遇中日韓文不再靜默或不同步，寫入狀態失敗也會清掉暫存檔。「Other agy model groups still have quota」現在只會在該回合實際通報 Antigravity 模型組跨過門檻時才附上。⟦跟辦公室共用交接白板一樣，以前換人簽收或寫進外文就容易漏看、還常附帶不相干備註，現在照統一格式交接，沒過線就不亂貼。⟧
body.en: Running Claude Code across several windows at once or typing in a Windows terminal used to drop warnings or suddenly stop responding. Now, when another conversation on the same account updates the state file, other conversations still receive quota warnings and new ones get their starting overview right away; after switching accounts with `/login`, idle conversations that switch later no longer mistake the limits for the old account. Standard input and output are now always read and written as UTF-8 (a universal text encoding across languages), so CJK text no longer causes silent failures or state desync, and failed state writes clean up their temporary file. "Other agy model groups still have quota" now appears only on turns that actually report an Antigravity model group crossing a threshold. ⟦A shared office handoff whiteboard works the same way: changing who signs off or writing in another language used to cause missed notes and unrelated remarks, whereas now everyone follows one format and nothing gets posted unless a line is crossed.⟧

items.original:
**Quota-aware mode keeps working across multiple conversations on the same Claude Code account.** When another conversation on the same account updates the status file last, existing conversations still receive Claude Code quota warnings and new conversations get their starting overview without waiting. After a `/login` switch in one conversation, idle conversations that switch later no longer mistake the already-updated numbers for the old account's limits.
**Quota-aware mode handles non-ASCII text on Windows, cleans up failed state writes, and stops adding unrelated Antigravity group notes.** It now reads stdin and writes stdout as UTF-8 instead of the system code page so CJK text no longer silences it or desynchronizes saved state from output, and removes its temporary file if saving state fails. The "Other agy model groups still have quota" line now appears only on turns that actually report an Antigravity model group crossing a threshold.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 狀態列改用在地語言顯示 xhigh 強度
title.en: Antigravity status line localizes the `xhigh` effort level

body.zh-TW: Gemini 4 Hydrogen 切到 `xhigh` 思考強度後，畫面上的狀態列（顯示即時設定資訊的文字欄）以前只會印出英文原名。現在這個顯示問題已經修好，狀態列會像其他思考強度一樣顯示在地化標籤，例如英文介面顯示為 `Extended`。⟦彷彿洗衣機面板原本只有幾段行程翻成中文、某個檔位卻硬生生留著英文代號，現在把最後那顆標籤也換成中文，瞄一眼就知道切到哪一檔。⟧
body.en: When switching Gemini 4 Hydrogen to the `xhigh` thinking effort, the status line (the text bar showing live settings) on screen used to print only the raw English name. That display bug is now fixed, and the status line shows a localized label like the other effort levels, such as `Extended` in English. ⟦An old washing machine panel had most cycles translated into Chinese while one setting stubbornly kept its English code, and now swapping out that last label lets you tell which gear you are on at a glance.⟧

items.original: **The Antigravity status line names the `xhigh` effort level.** Gemini 4 Hydrogen at `xhigh` used to show the raw English name. It now shows a localized label like the other levels, such as `Extended` in English.

entries: **Quota-aware mode now tells Claude when Claude Code or Codex has an official service incident.** When Claude Code / Claude API or Codex API is degraded or down, Claude gets one line saying so. For Codex it also says not to keep retrying a failed dispatch or debugging the task brief, and to switch agents or tell you instead. Claude hears it once per conversation, again if the status changes, and once more when the service recovers. The app writes these statuses to `~/.usage/service_status_snapshot.json`; statuses older than 15 minutes are ignored.

**Quota-aware mode tells Claude once when a quota it warned about resets.** The next prompt clears the earlier notice, including when a new quota window starts early, and includes current usage when known. Only quotas warned about in that conversation trigger a reset notice. Records for other conversations stay for up to seven days after reset so resumed conversations can hear it too.

**Quota-aware mode gives Claude a short quota overview at the start of each conversation.** It shows each tool’s known usage and reset time once, skips stale data, and waits for usable data if none is available yet. The same switch controls the overview and existing notices.

**Quota-aware mode tells Claude once when you switch Claude Code accounts with `/login`.** Earlier Claude Code quota notices no longer apply, and old account readings stay suppressed until the status file updates after your next reply. Other tools and conversations keep their own records.

**Quota-aware mode now tells Claude the reset clock time and the current time.** Each reminder used to give only the time left, such as `resets in 2h 10m`. It now adds the local clock time, such as `(at 02:40 local time)`, and a `Current local time` line, so Claude can tell you when a quota resets instead of only how long it takes. A reset on another day also shows the weekday.

**usage no longer opens Google sign-in pages in the background when the Antigravity CLI is signed out.** When a background `agy` run reports it is not signed in, usage stops starting `agy` in the background until the sign-in works again, and runs at most one background `agy` at a time. After you sign in again, the next refresh reads the quota right away instead of waiting 30 minutes.

**The Antigravity weekly quota no longer disappears after one failed read.** The card keeps the last weekly reading, marked as old data, until its reset time. The status line and quota-aware notices also treat the kept weekly reading as old data.

title.zh-TW: 官方服務出狀況時主動提醒 Claude
title.en: Proactive Alerts for Claude During Official Service Incidents

body.zh-TW: 請 Claude 派工給 Codex 整理資料時，最怕遇到服務中斷卻不自知，害它一直重試或忙著排查任務書。現在只要開啟「額度感知模式」（讓 usage 把外部狀態報給 Claude 的功能），當 Claude Code／Claude API 或 Codex API 發生降級或中斷時，Claude 就會收到一行提示。若出狀況的是 Codex，提示還會交代派工失敗別一直重試、別去改任務書，改派別隻或告訴你。同一個對話裡這件事只說一次，狀態變了再說，恢復正常時再說一次；app 會把狀態寫在 `~/.usage/service_status_snapshot.json`，超過 15 分鐘沒更新就不採用。⟦彷彿社區遭遇停水時，以前住戶沒收到通知只能反覆去轉水龍頭，現在水廠只在停水、水壓變動和恢復供水時各發一次通報，大家就不會白費力氣。⟧
body.en: When you ask Claude to dispatch a task to Codex to organize data, the worst thing is an unnoticed service outage that leaves Claude retrying endlessly or troubleshooting the task brief. Now, once you enable Quota-aware mode (the feature where usage reports external status to Claude), Claude receives a one-line notice whenever Claude Code / Claude API or Codex API is degraded or down. If Codex is the one having issues, the notice also instructs Claude not to keep retrying a failed dispatch or editing the task brief, and to switch agents or tell you instead. Claude hears this only once per conversation, again if the status changes, and once more when it recovers. The app writes the status to `~/.usage/service_status_snapshot.json`, and any status older than 15 minutes is ignored. ⟦Picture a neighborhood hit by a water shutoff: residents used to turn the faucet over and over without any notice, whereas now the water utility sends a single alert each for the shutoff, any pressure change, and the restoration of service so no one wastes effort.⟧

For Codex it also says not to keep retrying a failed dispatch or debugging the task brief, and to switch agents or tell you instead. title.zh-TW: 對話開場附上額度總覽與本地重置時間
title.en: Quota Overview and Local Reset Times at Conversation Start

body.zh-TW: 剛開一個新對話準備寫企劃時，你常得先確認手上各工具還有多少額度、幾點才會重新計算。⟦就像走進診所先看牆上的看板，以前只寫「再等兩小時」得自己心算，現在螢幕開門就列出各診進度，並直接標出幾點幾分輪到你。⟧只要開啟「額度感知模式」，每個對話開始時都會遞給 Claude 一份簡短總覽，把各工具已知的用量與重置時間報告一次，並略過過期資料。如果當時還沒有可用資料，就會等到有可用資料時再提供總覽，而且這份總覽與原有的額度提醒共用同一個開關。以往提醒只寫還剩多久，例如 `resets in 2h 10m`，現在會補上本地時間 `(at 02:40 local time)`，並多附一行 `Current local time`。如果不在當天重置，還會加上星期幾，Claude 就能直接回答你幾點重置，不必只說還要等多久。
body.en: When you open a new conversation to draft a proposal, you often have to check how much quota each tool has left and what time it resets. ⟦Think of walking into a clinic and checking the wall board: it used to say only "wait another two hours" and leave you doing the math, whereas now the screen greets you with each room's progress and the exact time of your turn.⟧ As long as Quota-aware mode is enabled, each conversation starts by handing Claude a short overview that reports each tool's known usage and reset time once while skipping stale data. If no usable data is available yet, it waits until usable data arrives before providing the overview, and this overview shares the same switch as existing quota notices. Reminders used to state only how much time was left, such as `resets in 2h 10m`, and now they add the local clock time `(at 02:40 local time)` along with a `Current local time` line. If the reset is on another day, it also includes the weekday, so Claude can tell you the exact reset time instead of only how long you have to wait.

title.zh-TW: 額度重置或用 /login 換帳號後，清除先前的提醒
title.en: Clear Earlier Notices After a Quota Reset or /login Switch

body.zh-TW: 午休過後重新開啟昨晚的討論串，或剛切換了另一組登入身分想繼續趕工，Claude 卻可能還記著先前的用量警告。⟦好比信用卡到了結帳日或換張新卡結帳，以前舊的「快刷爆」紙條還留在桌上誤導人，現在帳務一旦重算或換卡，就會撕掉舊紙條不再沿用舊數字。⟧現在只要先前提醒過的額度重置（包含提前開始新一輪額度），下次送出訊息時「額度感知模式」就會通知 Claude 一次舊提醒已失效，讀得到目前用量時也會一併附上。只有同一對話曾提醒過的額度才會觸發通知，而其他對話的紀錄會保留到重置後七天，恢復對話時照樣收得到。當你用 `/login` 切換 Claude Code 帳號後，同樣會告訴 Claude 一次先前提醒已不適用；在下一次回覆更新狀態檔前，不會沿用舊帳號的讀數，其他工具與對話則保留各自紀錄。
body.en: After lunch, you might reopen last night's thread or switch to another sign-in to keep working, only to find Claude still remembering an earlier usage warning. ⟦A credit card hits its billing date or gets swapped for a new one: an old "almost maxed out" sticky note used to stay on the desk and mislead you, whereas now resetting the cycle or changing cards tears up that note instead of carrying over old numbers.⟧ Now, whenever a previously warned quota resets (including when a new quota window starts early), Quota-aware mode tells Claude once on your next prompt that the earlier notice no longer applies, and includes current usage when available. Only quotas warned about in that conversation trigger the notice, while records for other conversations stay for up to seven days after reset so resumed conversations still receive it. When you switch Claude Code accounts with `/login`, Claude is likewise told once that earlier notices no longer apply; old account readings are not reused until the status file updates after your next reply, while other tools and conversations keep their own records.

items.original:
**Quota-aware mode tells Claude once when a quota it warned about resets.** The next prompt clears the earlier notice, including when a new quota window starts early, and includes current usage when known. Only quotas warned about in that conversation trigger a reset notice. Records for other conversations stay for up to seven days after reset so resumed conversations can hear it too.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Antigravity 背景跳出登入頁與週額度消失
title.en: Fix Antigravity Background Sign-In Pop-Ups and Vanishing Weekly Quota

body.zh-TW: 正在專心寫東西時，瀏覽器卻突然自己打開要求驗證帳號，回頭看面板上的本週剩餘數字也憑空蒸發。現在當 Antigravity CLI（指令列工具 `agy`）處於未登入狀態，usage 背景執行發現沒登入後，就會停止在背景啟動 `agy` 並改為同一時間最多只跑一支，不再一直跳出 Google 登入頁。等你重新登入恢復後，下一次刷新就會立刻讀取額度，不用再乾等 30 分鐘。遇到單次讀取失敗時，Antigravity 的週額度也不會直接消失，卡片會沿用上次的週額度並標示為舊資料，直到重置時間為止；狀態列與額度感知提醒同樣會把它當作舊資料處理。⟦宛如抄錶員上門記錄度數，以前沒應門就一直按門鈴，抄不到還把欄位擦成空白；現在屋主不在就先暫停敲門，偶爾漏抄也暫留蓋有舊印章的數字。⟧
body.en: While you are focused on writing, your browser might suddenly open on its own asking to verify your account, and the weekly remaining number on the panel vanishes. Now, when the Antigravity CLI (the command-line tool `agy`) is signed out and a background usage run detects it, usage stops launching `agy` in the background and runs at most one instance at a time, so Google sign-in pages stop popping up repeatedly. Once you sign in again, the next refresh reads the quota right away instead of making you wait 30 minutes. After a single failed read, the Antigravity weekly quota no longer disappears either: the card keeps the last weekly reading and marks it as old data until its reset time, while the status line and quota-aware notices also treat it as old data. ⟦Like a meter reader visiting a home to record usage, they used to keep ringing the doorbell when no one answered and wipe the field blank when a read failed, whereas now they pause knocking when the homeowner is away and temporarily keep the old-stamped reading after an occasional missed read.⟧

**usage no longer opens Google sign-in pages in the background when the Antigravity CLI is signed out.** When a background `agy` run reports it is not signed in, usage stops starting `agy` in the background until the sign-in works again, and runs at most one background `agy` at a time. After you sign in again, the next refresh reads the quota right away instead of waiting 30 minutes.
**The Antigravity weekly quota no longer disappears after one failed read.** The card keeps the last weekly reading, marked as old data, until its reset time. The status line and quota-aware notices also treat the kept weekly reading as old data.

entries: **The Antigravity status line shows when each quota resets.** Next to the 5-hour and weekly percentages it now prints the reset clock time and the time left, for example `18:37(2h30m left)`, in the same format as the Claude Code status line.

**Terse mode keeps replies readable while it shortens them.** Its instructions now set a floor: the reader gets each reply in one pass. They ask for common word pairings and the verb near its subject, and keep connecting words such as "because" and "so". This follows a recent study that found pressure to be brief is one cause of hard-to-read AI text.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 狀態列改為雙排顯示，補上額度重置時刻與剩餘時間
title.en: Antigravity status line switches to two lines, adding quota reset times and time remaining

body.zh-TW: 緊盯著邊長受限的終端機視窗趕工時，最怕算不清手邊的呼叫配額何時重置。⟦走進候車亭看動態看板，以前單排螢幕擠不下完整字樣，抵達時間常最先被裁切；現在改成分層播送，上方列出路線、下方顯示倒數分鐘，小螢幕也能一眼看齊。⟧Antigravity 的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）現在採用雙排設計，排版樣式比照 Claude Code。第一排固定保留專案與額度視窗，第二排則放模型與上下文視窗（模型一次可處理的內容容量）。在 5 小時和每週額度的百分比旁，會直接印出重置時刻與剩餘時間，例如 `18:37(2h30m left)`，意思是 18:37 重置、還剩 2 小時 30 分鐘。即使終端機只有 80 格寬，重置時間依然放得下，不再被優先省略。
body.en: When rushing through work while watching a space-constrained terminal window, the worst feeling is losing track of when active call quotas reset. ⟦Think of checking a dynamic display at a bus shelter: where a single-row screen once could not fit all text and cut off arrival times first, a tiered broadcast now lists routes on top and countdown minutes below, letting small screens show everything at a glance.⟧ Antigravity's status line (the status display at the bottom of the terminal) now uses a two-line layout modeled after Claude Code. The first line keeps project and quota windows, while the second line holds the model and context window (the amount of content a model can process at once). Next to the 5-hour and weekly percentages, it prints the reset clock time and time left, such as `18:37(2h30m left)`, meaning it resets at 18:37 with 2 hours and 30 minutes left. Even if the terminal is only 80 columns wide, reset times still fit and are no longer dropped first.

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式兼顧文字可讀性，縮短回覆依然讀一遍就懂
title.en: Terse mode preserves readability, keeping shortened replies clear in one pass

body.zh-TW: 請 AI 簡明扼要回答問題時，最常遇到文字被過度壓縮而難以理解的窘境。⟦報社主編濃縮長篇通訊，以前為了塞進有限版面猛砍連接詞，讀者讀起來反而滿頭問號；現在改寫時要求句型完整且詞語自然，篇幅變短卻依然一讀就通。⟧精簡模式（terse mode，縮減回覆長度的輸出模式）現在替回覆品質設下底線，要求讀者讀一遍就能看懂。這套指示要求語句採用常見的慣用搭配詞，動詞必須盡量靠近主詞，並強制保留「因為」與「所以」等關鍵連接詞。這項改進依據一項最新研究：逼迫 AI 寫短，正是其文字變得晦澀難懂的原因之一。
body.en: When asking an AI for concise answers, users often encounter text compressed so heavily that it becomes hard to understand. ⟦Picture a newspaper editor condensing long dispatches: where conjunctions were once aggressively cut to fit limited space and left readers puzzled, rewrites now require complete sentence structures and natural phrasing so shortened copy remains clear in one pass.⟧ Terse mode (an output mode that shortens reply length) now sets a quality floor, requiring that readers understand each reply in one pass. These instructions require common word pairings, keep the verb as close as possible to its subject, and mandate preserving key connecting words such as "because" and "so". This improvement follows a recent study: pressuring AI to be brief is itself one reason its text becomes obscure and hard to understand.

items.original: **Terse mode keeps replies readable while it shortens them.** Its instructions now set a floor: the reader gets each reply in one pass. They ask for common word pairings and the verb near its subject, and keep connecting words such as "because" and "so". This follows a recent study that found pressure to be brief is one cause of hard-to-read AI text.

title.zh-TW: Codex 子代理用量重新計入，獨立統計不再整份略過
title.en: Codex subagent usage is counted again, tracked independently instead of skipping whole files

body.zh-TW: 指揮背景代理分頭處理繁重任務之後，翻開用量報告卻可能發現統計數據對不上。⟦工讀生協助分裝包裹，以前簽收單雖寫著總部抬頭卻漏貼明細，會計對不上總帳便整批退件；現在獨立開立單據從零計算，派工產生的開銷全部如實入帳。⟧由 `spawn_agent` 啟動的子代理執行緒會複製父層工作階段的開頭標頭，卻不再複製父層的 token（計量 AI 處理與計費的文字單位）事件。過去 usage 因為無法將它對齊父對話，會將整份紀錄檔直接略過。現在這類子代理紀錄已改為從零開始統計。在發現此問題的電腦上，先前大約少算了 0.4% 的 Codex token 用量。
body.en: After directing background agents to handle heavy tasks in parallel, opening a usage report might reveal figures that fail to match. ⟦An intern helps pack parcels: while receipt slips once showed headquarters headers but omitted itemized details, prompting accounting to reject whole batches when totals failed to match, independent invoices are now issued from scratch so all dispatch expenses are recorded faithfully.⟧ A subagent thread launched by `spawn_agent` copies the header of the parent session, but no longer copies the parent's token (the text unit used to measure AI processing and billing) events. Previously, because usage could not match it to the parent conversation, it skipped the entire log file. These subagent records are now counted from zero instead. On the machine where this issue was found, about 0.4% of Codex token usage had previously gone uncounted.

items.original: **Codex subagent threads are counted again.** A thread started by `spawn_agent` repeats the parent's session header but no longer its token events, so usage could not match it to the parent and skipped the whole file. These threads are now counted from zero; on the machine where it was found, about 0.4% of Codex tokens had been missing.

title.zh-TW: Fable 5.2 補上離線價格備援，圖表統一顯示簡稱
title.en: Fable 5.2 adds an offline price fallback, displaying a short name across charts

body.zh-TW: 遇到網路斷線或離線工作的場合，查看模型支出報表常會因為缺乏即時價目而留下空白。⟦便利商店刷條碼結帳，以前連不上總部系統就直接顯示無此商品，發票品名也印得落落長；現在機台內建離線公定價，收據上更統一印出簡潔的商品代號。⟧針對 Fable 5.2 模型，系統現在內建了離線價格設定。價目表無法下載時，Fable 5.2 的費用也不再顯示為缺漏。各類用量表格與統計圖表也統一將其名稱標示為簡潔的 `Fable 5.2`。
body.en: When working offline or experiencing a network disconnection, reviewing model spending reports often left blanks because real-time pricing was unavailable. ⟦At a convenience store barcode checkout, losing connection to headquarters once prompted registers to display items as missing while printing overly long names on receipts; machines now embed offline list prices and consistently print concise product codes instead.⟧ For the Fable 5.2 model, the system now includes built-in offline pricing. When the price table cannot be downloaded, costs for Fable 5.2 no longer show as missing. Usage tables and charts also consistently display its name as the concise `Fable 5.2`.

items.original: **Fable 5.2 has an offline price and a short name.** Costs for it no longer show as missing when the price table cannot be downloaded, and it appears as `Fable 5.2` in tables and charts.

entries: **The Antigravity Gemini weekly quota keeps updating on networks that only allow traffic through a proxy.** The pre-launch check from 0.34.14 connected to Google directly, so behind a proxy it always looked offline and the CLI never ran. A configured HTTPS proxy now counts as online; a bare `NO_PROXY` setting still runs the check.
**The offline check can no longer hold up a refresh when DNS hangs after a wake.** Its 3-second limit now covers the name lookup, not just the connection.

**The Antigravity auto-start window keeper now follows the Gemini quota, whichever model group the card shows.** It always sends its message to a Gemini model, but decided from the displayed group, so with Claude/GPT or Argon selected it started the window at the wrong time or never.
**The Gemini weekly quota no longer jumps into the 5-hour row in its last five hours.** When usage falls back to Google's model list, a weekly limit close to its reset was mistaken for a 5-hour one.
**Signing in to Antigravity again takes effect on the next refresh.** After Google rejected the sign-in, usage kept retrying the rejected token for up to an hour.
**A damaged Antigravity quota cache no longer hides the card for good.** An unreadable cache file is now moved to `~/.usage/quarantine/` and the quota is fetched fresh.
**On Windows, the taskbar countdown starts and clears promptly with the panel closed.** It could lag up to five minutes when a quota filled or reset between refreshes.

title.zh-TW: 代理網路正常更新額度，喚醒網址查詢不再拖住刷新
title.en: Quotas Update Normally over Proxy Networks, Wake-Up URL Queries No Longer Stall Refreshes

body.zh-TW: 在特定企業內網工作時，你可能需要透過代理伺服器（替電腦轉發對外請求的中介伺服器）連上外部網路。v0.34.14 新增的啟動前檢查會直接連線 Google，導致走代理的環境總被判定成離線，造成工具無法執行。現在只要設定好 HTTPS 代理就會視為連線成功，每週額度也能正常更新，僅設定 `NO_PROXY` 時則照常檢查。⟦宛若大樓警衛核對訪客，以前只認正門直達通道，走接駁車通道就被當成缺席，翻閱名冊卡住時還會堵住入口；現在認可接駁登記，查名冊的時間也計入等待上限。⟧電腦睡眠喚醒若遇到網域名稱查詢卡住，原本 3 秒的上限現在連同查網址的時間一併計算，不再拖住資料刷新。
body.en: When working on certain corporate intranets, you might need to connect to external networks through a proxy server (an intermediary server forwarding outbound requests for a computer). The pre-launch check added in v0.34.14 connected directly to Google, which caused environments behind a proxy to always be judged offline and prevented tools from running. Now, configuring an HTTPS proxy counts as a successful connection and weekly quotas update normally, while setting only `NO_PROXY` continues to run the check as before. ⟦Think of a building security guard checking visitors who previously only recognized the direct front entrance, treated anyone arriving via shuttle bus as absent, and clogged the gate whenever flipping through the guest registry stalled; now shuttle check-ins are recognized, and registry lookup time counts toward the waiting limit.⟧ If a domain name query hangs when waking from computer sleep, the original 3-second limit now includes the URL lookup time as well, no longer stalling data refreshes.

items.original:
**The Antigravity Gemini weekly quota keeps updating on networks that only allow traffic through a proxy.** The pre-launch check from 0.34.14 connected to Google directly, so behind a proxy it always looked offline and the CLI never ran. A configured HTTPS proxy now counts as online; a bare `NO_PROXY` setting still runs the check.
**The offline check can no longer hold up a refresh when DNS hangs after a wake.** Its 3-second limit now covers the name lookup, not just the connection.

title.zh-TW: 自動開窗改依 Gemini 額度判斷，切換其他模型組不再誤判時機
title.en: Auto-Start Window Keeper Now Follows Gemini Quota, Switching Model Groups No Longer Misjudges Timing

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟 Antigravity 的自動保持開窗功能時，背後機制會依照額度狀態決定觸發視窗的時間點。⟦跟工廠派車載貨一樣，司機固定駕駛卡車，調度員以前卻看展示架上的小客車油表決定發車，導致在錯的時間出發或乾脆不出勤；現在改看卡車的油量，不再算錯發車時機。⟧該功能一律向 Gemini 模型送出訊息，以前卻依照卡片上目前顯示的模型組來判斷額度。當你選取了 Claude、GPT 或 Argon 模型組時，開窗機制便會在錯誤的時間啟動，甚至完全不開窗。現在開窗判定已經改為直接追蹤 Gemini 的額度，無論介面切換到哪一個模型組，都不會再錯過時機。
body.en: When you enable Antigravity's auto-start window keeper feature, the underlying mechanism determines when to trigger a window based on quota status. ⟦Picture a factory dispatching freight trucks: the driver always operates a truck, but dispatchers previously checked the fuel gauge of a sedan on display to schedule trips, leading to departures at the wrong time or no runs at all; now they monitor the truck's fuel level, no longer miscalculating dispatch timing.⟧ This feature always sends messages to a Gemini model, but previously evaluated quota based on whichever model group the card currently displayed. When you selected the Claude, GPT, or Argon model group, the window mechanism would start at the wrong time or never open at all. Now the windowing decision directly tracks Gemini's quota, so whichever model group the interface switches to, it will no longer miss the timing.
